messages.subject: bare bones "hello world" RApache example
parts:
This page:

http://labs.dataspora.com/R/helloworld

is generated by this script,

/var/www/R/helloworld.R

##
main <- function() {
setContentType("text/html")
png("/var/www/images/hello.png")
plot(sample(100,100),col=1:8,pch=19)
dev.off()
cat("<html>")
cat("<body>")
cat("<h1>hello world</h1>")
cat('<img src="/images/hello.png"')
cat("</body>")
cat("</html>")
}

## which depends on having this snippet in apache2.conf:
##
<Location "/R/helloworld">
ROutputErrors
Options indexes FollowSymLinks
SetHandler r-handler
RFileHandler /var/www/R/helloworld.R::main
</Location>

## make sure /var/www/images exists and has the proper permissions set.
